title: ⑨ 完整服务、命名模型与远端存储对照

core_execution_audit.scope: successful Core submissions on the persistent online-serving kernel; excludes planner previews, isolated replay and pre-serving initialization
core_execution_audit.method: instrumented DramCore/NandCore submit and submit_many, selected by live PhysicalRuntimeContext identity

metadata.known_values: component capacity and one-way directional bandwidth
analytical_assumptions: channel count unless separately cited by the preset
rank, bank, row and burst organization
open/close, command-to-data and recovery timings
burst interval is a payload scheduling budget, not measured tCCD
bank-group column/ACT/WRITE-to-READ timings and four-ACT window are unspecified (zero disables each constraint)
metadata.capacity_basis: declared capacity with an equivalent geometry rounded upward to whole rows
metadata.bandwidth_basis: explicit component one-way bandwidth; synthetic lane width does not infer pin speed
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent interface rate derived from declared aggregate bandwidth and synthetic width; not a measured pin speed

metadata.geometry_basis: equivalent geometry; not a vendor die or bank specification
metadata.timing_basis: legacy zero bank-group timing control; other array timings are analytical assumptions
metadata.published_input_scope: capacity, stack count and directional bandwidth are caller-selected published inputs; geometry and unspecified timing remain explicit synthetic assumptions

limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.
Physical bytes are Core result counters; NAND internal/host transfer bytes are separate from media read/program bytes.
Instrumenting these process-global entry points requires one simulation thread per process.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

core_execution_audit.method: instrumented DramCore/NandCore submit and submit_many, selected by live PhysicalRuntimeContext identity

metadata.known_values: component capacity and one-way directional bandwidth
analytical_assumptions: channel count unless separately cited by the preset
rank, bank, row and burst organization
open/close, command-to-data and recovery timings
burst interval is a payload scheduling budget, not measured tCCD
bank-group column/ACT/WRITE-to-READ timings and four-ACT window are unspecified (zero disables each constraint)
metadata.capacity_basis: declared capacity with an equivalent geometry rounded upward to whole rows
metadata.bandwidth_basis: explicit component one-way bandwidth; synthetic lane width does not infer pin speed
metadata.data_rate_basis: equivalent interface rate derived from declared aggregate bandwidth and synthetic width; not a measured pin speed

metadata.geometry_basis: equivalent geometry; not a vendor die or bank specification
metadata.timing_basis: legacy zero bank-group timing control; other array timings are analytical assumptions
metadata.published_input_scope: capacity, stack count and directional bandwidth are caller-selected published inputs; geometry and unspecified timing remain explicit synthetic assumptions

metadata.geometry_basis: equivalent channel/plane/page geometry; not a disclosed device layout
metadata.timing_basis: explicit read, program and erase assumptions; no external calibration
metadata.published_input_scope: capacity, read/write bandwidth, page size and page latency are caller-selected published inputs; undisclosed geometry is an equivalent analytical mapping
metadata.bandwidth_mapping: effective shared tier on host leg; internal leg is 1000 times shared host bandwidth
metadata.parallelism_mapping: explicit effective units, otherwise ceil(read bandwidth * page read latency / page bytes); channels map one-to-one to effective units

limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.
Physical bytes are Core result counters; NAND internal/host transfer bytes are separate from media read/program bytes.
Instrumenting these process-global entry points requires one simulation thread per process.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included
memory_metrics.host_admission_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues
storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

metadata.published_input_scope: capacity, read/write bandwidth, page size and page latency are caller-selected published inputs; undisclosed geometry is an equivalent analytical mapping
metadata.bandwidth_mapping: effective shared tier on host leg; internal leg is 1000 times shared host bandwidth
metadata.parallelism_mapping: explicit effective units, otherwise ceil(read bandwidth * page read latency / page bytes); channels map one-to-one to effective units

limitations: Cohort phase attribution follows actual execution; mixed cohorts are not split artificially.
Physical bytes are Core result counters; NAND internal/host transfer bytes are separate from media read/program bytes.
Instrumenting these process-global entry points requires one simulation thread per process.

rows.measurement_window: earliest request arrival through simulation end, including initialization wait

measurement_windows.semantics: primary rates span earliest request arrival through simulation end; TTFT/E2E start at each request arrival; runtime rates exclude initialization

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included
memory_metrics.host_admission_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues
storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

prefill.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

decode.semantics: wall rate uses completed requests' input tokens once for prefill and committed non-prefill output tokens for decode; both use the primary request window. Busy rate includes scheduled/recomputed work; mixed batches overlap and busy rates are not additive

memory_metrics.scope: operator NAND traffic (HBF/SSD); separately reported KV migration traffic is not implicitly included
memory_metrics.host_admission_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues

active_service_lane_imbalance.semantics: busy-time imbalance among observed effective service lanes; not a physical-plane measurement and not all configured idle lanes

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

unavailable.physical_plane_imbalance: detailed physical-plane observations not enabled; effective lanes are distinct
unavailable.read_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded
unavailable.program_queue_depth: page-level queue occupancy timeline not recorded

memory_metrics.semantics: GB/s equals bytes/ns; logical/media ratios include RMW and merging and must not be called physical page fill fractions

migration_ledger.scope: physical KV pool transfers, separate from operator NAND traffic; explicit endpoints and completion times

prefetch.semantics: fraction of completed lookahead bytes consumed by resumed requests; not learned-router prediction accuracy

prefetch_overlap.scope: intersection with realized GPU operator stages of other requests; host setup and GPU frontend/controller stages excluded; operator envelopes may include memory stalls, not tensor-core busy time

rows.quantile_scope: empirical interpolation over reported sample count; no population tail-latency guarantee

address_assumptions.embedding: No token-ID trace is supplied. Analytical remote embedding row traffic uses a bounded cyclic address model when reads exceed the resident table; repeated traffic is retained and the allocation is not enlarged. This is not a measured token locality trace.

kv.prefetch_metric_semantics: useful bytes are completed copies exposed to a successful consumer cohort; unused bytes include reclaimed copies and completed copies not consumed; transfer time sums per-page latency and is not GPU stall time; opt-in lifecycle cancellation drains submitted physical phases, preserves their cost, then frees the destination; cancelled bytes are separate from completed/unused bytes
modeling_limits: offload_ratio bounds pressure-triggered migratable capacity; it is not a per-token mirror ratio
prefetch disabled when prefetch_distance=0
logical KV traffic counters are not added to resource-accounted bytes when attention kernels already include local memory traffic
KV read means external persisted-cache access only; prefill/recompute historical-prompt attention remains modeled as causal compute and ordinary attention/activation traffic

dram_traffic.accounting_semantics: resolved analytical burst bytes and controller waits; null means not fully recorded; empty organization_profiles is not evidence of complete geometry reporting; no device accuracy claim

storage_traffic.queue_depth_scope: max per-device outstanding host requests sampled at admission, including the new request; buffered writes end at host acknowledgement; not NAND page/program queues
storage_traffic.page_utilization_scope: logical payload / sum of per-access page-rounded spans; repeated accesses count again; not unique resident capacity utilization

nand_read_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host requests are separate

nand_program_queue_depth.reason: page-level observation is opt-in; host writes are separate

storage_traffic.accounting_semantics: host_transfer_bytes is logical host payload; physical_* and pages_read/pages_programmed are NAND media accounting; null means not fully recorded; operation_counts classifies task-owner ledgers, not media operations; service_ns is analytical

supported: 完整GPU/算子/服务调度时间线

limitations: Hardware is hypothetical: the base inventory is one GPU, 512 GiB HBM and 1 TiB HBF; 405B pairs explicitly expand HBM to 1 TiB. Unused capacity is retained in each comparison budget.

70B/1M retains its original 512 GiB HBM capacity controls including physical contiguous-allocation failures, and adds a separate A/B/D comparison with 1 TiB HBM for every architecture. The non-moving first-fit allocator may reject an extent despite enough total free bytes because free space is fragmented. This is not proof that the model's theoretical aggregate demand exceeds 512 GiB, nor that 1 TiB is the minimum hardware capacity. Rejections have no TPS and must not be paired against a successful run with different capacity.
C uses priority preemption, physical KV swap and resume, not an agent pause/resume API.
Named model architecture presets retain their true layers/weights; GPU compute remains an uncalibrated analytical model.
Contexts beyond each preset native limit are architecture extrapolation stress tests, without model quality claims.
E uses host DRAM over the declared PCIe/DDR path; G adds a local CXL-attached DRAM path. Neither is a rack-scale shared multi-GPU memory experiment.
F models cold KV on a hypothetical 7 GB/s read, 4 GB/s write NVMe tier with 50 us read and 800 us program; component hbf0 is replaced by kind=ssd for this baseline.
Migration accounting is reported independently from operator storage_traffic; it must not be interpreted as zero migration when storage task_count is zero.
Prefetch overlap uses realized GPU operator envelopes, not whole batches or host setup. Zero overlap remains a negative finding; no latency-hiding success is inferred from useful bytes alone.

Extended named-model pairs use the repository presets without fabricated missing models. Llama 405B pairs expand HBM to 1 TiB for both architectures; Qwen MoE presets retain their declared analytical approximation limitations.
Speculative decoding uses a synthetic explicit MTP branch and deterministic expected-prefix acceptance; probability parameters are not empirical model acceptance or quality measurements.

8B/70B 2K rows generate 32 output tokens; extended named-model 2K and long-context rows generate only four and are prefill-dominated. These finite traces do not establish production tail latency or stable service capacity.
